They want to calculate the business class fare from the first airport in the available list to the last airport in the same list, on the last day of October 2024. Provide estimated total payable amount.

That returns cost in USD. Then we need to provide estimated total payable amount. But we also need to consider booking? The user wants to arrange a flight on booking number 1234. But we don't have booking details. We might need to cancel booking? Or just compute cost? The user wants to compute cost. So we need to get flight cost. Then provide estimated total payable amount. We might need to get credit card balance? But not necessary. The user didn't ask to book. They just want to compute cost. So we can call get_flight_cost. But we need to get airports first. So call list_all_airports. Then get first and last. Then call get_flight_cost. Then provide estimated total payable amount. We might need to mention that we cannot book because we don't have card info. But we can compute cost.

Thus we need to call list_all_airports. Then call get_flight_cost. Then respond.
